diff --git a/throttle/limiter.py b/throttle/limiter.py
index 2576114..22722c7 100644
--- a/throttle/limiter.py
+++ b/throttle/limiter.py
@@ -14,6 +14,7 @@ class Limiter:
         self.on_limit = on_limit
         self._counts: dict[str, int] = {}
         self._blocked: set[str] = set()
+        self._limit_fired: set[str] = set()
 
     def hit(self, key: str) -> bool:
         """Record one hit for ``key``; True when the hit is allowed."""
@@ -21,4 +22,7 @@ class Limiter:
         self._counts[key] = count
         if count > self.threshold:
             self._blocked.add(key)
+            if key not in self._limit_fired and self.on_limit is not None:
+                self.on_limit(key)
+                self._limit_fired.add(key)
         return count <= self.threshold
